register.labelZh: DRINK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: drink in 可以表示欣賞美景、細心聆聽別人的說話,或充分感受周圍的氣氛。；drink something down 着重迅速喝下;drink something up 則着重把飲品喝完。；drink to somebody or something 適合在婚禮、慶祝活動、聚餐和其他特別場合使用。；drink up 和 drink to somebody 等表達經常出現在日常對話、電影和社交場合中。
register.summaryEn: Drink in can describe enjoying a beautiful view, listening closely to someone or fully experiencing an atmosphere. Drink something down focuses on drinking quickly, while drink something up focuses on finishing the drink. Drink to somebody or something is useful at weddings, celebrations, meals and other special events. Expressions such as drink up and drink to somebody often appear in daily conversations, films and social events.
